BREAKING | South Korea / Space
NURI ROCKET DEPLOYS FIRST DOMESTIC MICROSATELLITE CONSTELLATION

South Korea’s homegrown Nuri rocket completed its fifth flight on Oct. 7, successfully deploying five NEONSAT Earth-observation microsatellites plus nine CubeSats. The Korea AeroSpace Administration called it a milestone for multi-satellite constellation launches.

Sources: Yonhap News Agency https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20261007005452320

EVERGREEN | Space / STEM
NASA’S WEBB REVEALS STELLAR NURSERY NGC 7129

NASA’s James Webb Space Telescope released a new infrared portrait of star-forming region NGC 7129, about 3,300 light-years away, showing protostars, outflows, and glowing hydrogen once hidden by dust.

Sources: NASA Science (Webb Mission Team) https://science.nasa.gov/missions/webb/nasas-webb-captures-commotion-from-nebulas-stellar-jets/

BREAKING | Türkiye / Space
TÜRKİYE COMPLETES INTEGRATION OF ITS FIRST LUNAR SPACECRAFT

TÜBİTAK UZAY finished production and integration of Türkiye’s first lunar spacecraft (over 80% domestic content). It heads to environmental testing ahead of a planned early-2027 polar lunar orbit mission.

Sources: TÜBİTAK (official) https://tubitak.gov.tr/en/news/integration-activities-completed-turkiyes-first-lunar-spacecraft

BREAKING | Canada / Space
CANADIAN COMPANY’S FIRST SATELLITE WORKING WELL IN ORBIT

Ontario-based NordSpace says its pathfinder satellite Terra Nova completed early-orbit checks after riding a Falcon 9, marking the firm the first aspiring Canadian rocket company with its own hardware in space.

Sources: CP24 / CTV News https://www.cp24.com/news/canada/2026/10/07/days-after-launch-canadian-companys-first-satellite-is-working-well-in-orbit/

EVERGREEN | Astronomy / STEM
ALMA FINDS RARE “HEAVY” METHANOL AROUND A YOUNG STAR

An international ALMA COMPASS team reported the first interstellar detection of fully deuterated methanol (CD₃OD) around protostar IRAS 4A2 in the Perseus cloud, about 1,000 light-years away—a clue to organic chemistry near planet-building zones.

Sources: National Radio Astronomy Observatory (NSF NRAO) https://public.nrao.edu/news/cosmic-cocktail-alma-compass/

EVERGREEN | United Kingdom / Nature
DEVON TEENS RECRUIT KIDS TO HELP RESTORE HARVEST MICE

Two 14-year-old conservationists in Devon, England, who previously released 250 harvest mice, launched Wild Pets to recruit ages 8–13 to breed and later release Britain’s smallest rodent, listed Near Threatened by the Mammal Society.

Sources: BBC News (Devon) https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cjqlnreelze9o

EVERGREEN | India / Conservation
ANDAMAN STUDENTS EXPLORE ISLAND BIODIVERSITY FOR WILDLIFE WEEK

During India’s 72nd Wildlife Week, South Andaman students birded and trekked at Mount Manipur National Park (about 20 bird species observed), while Andaman College students toured Chidiyatapu Biological Park for endemic flora and fauna awareness.

Sources: The Wave Andaman https://thewaveandaman.com/wildlife-week-andaman-students-birding-trekking-biodiversity/

EVERGREEN | India / Education
LADAKH STUDENTS JOIN ‘KNOW YOUR WILD NEIGHBOUR’ FIELD DAY

Ladakh’s Department of Wildlife Protection held a Wildlife Week field tour and quiz at Government High School Chowkiyal, Drass, teaching students about high-altitude flora, fauna, and mountain habitats.

Sources: Administration of Union Territory of Ladakh https://ladakh.gov.in/department-of-wildlife-protection-organizes-know-your-wild-neighbour-program-at-ghs-chowkiyal-drass/

EVERGREEN | Space / STEM
SPACEX SHARES STARSHIP FOOTAGE OF STARLINK SATELLITE DEPLOYMENT

SpaceX released camera footage of Starship deploying Starlink satellites in orbit, highlighting early communication and autonomous control as large constellations grow.

Sources: India Today (Science) https://www.indiatoday.in/science/story/spacex-starship-starlink-satellite-deployment-footage-orbital-communication-3011470-2026-10-07

EDITOR’S BOX — Oct 7 International desk (G–PG)

Oct 2 Spain/Europe pack retired. Plate rated G–PG for under-13 standing (disaster weather, hunting, and intense collision wires dropped). Lead: Nuri / NEONSAT. Watch: Türkiye lunar environmental tests; NordSpace commissioning; youth wildlife programs. Print lock: curated from International plate draft ~07:40 CDT 2026-10-07.
